description: Grants ERC-20 allowance to the Boson Protocol contract. Must be called before commit_to_offer or deposit_funds when using non-native exchange tokens, unless you relay in metaTx mode with transferAuthorizations (built with a sign_receive_with_* tool) passed to send_meta_transaction. Returns unsigned transaction data.

configId.description: Boson/Fermion Protocol deployment identifier. Format: '<env>-<chainId>-<index>' e.g. 'production-137-0' (Polygon mainnet), 'testing-80002-0' (Amoy testnet). Call get_config_ids to list all valid values for this server.

exchangeTokenAddress.description: ERC-20 token contract address to approve for the Boson Protocol diamond.

executionMode.description: 'direct' = standard on-chain tx (sign locally with your wallet → send_signed_transaction). 'metaTx' = gasless relay via Biconomy (send_meta_transaction). Defaults to 'direct'.

signerAddress.description: Ethereum address that will sign and send this transaction. Must match the wallet that will sign the returned transaction locally.

name: approve_exchange_token
